sql:
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT
        MaHoaDon,
        NgayLap,
        ThoiGianLap,
        MaKhachHang,
        MaNhanVien,
        KenhBanHang,
        PhuongThucTT,
        TinhTrang,
        _huy,
        _tra
    FROM "don_hang"
),
lines AS (
    SELECT
        d.MaHoaDon,
        d.NgayLap,
        d.ThoiGianLap,
        d.MaKhachHang,
        d.MaNhanVien,
        d.KenhBanHang,
        d.PhuongThucTT,
        d.TinhTrang,
        d._huy,
        d._tra,
        l.MaHangHoa,
        l.SLQuyDoi,
        l.DonViTinh,
        l.TriGia,
        p.DanhMuc,
        p.TenGoi AS CatName,
        p.TenGoi AS ProdName
    FROM "don_hang" d
    JOIN "chi_tiet_don" l ON d.MaHoaDon = l.MaHoaDon
    LEFT JOIN "san_pham" p ON l.MaHangHoa = p.MaHangHoa
),
customers AS (
    SELECT
        MaKhachHang,
        TenGoi
    FROM "khach_hang"
)
SELECT
    CAST(strftime(o.NgayLap, '%Y%m%d') || '-' || o.MaHoaDon AS VARCHAR) AS order_id,
    CAST(o.NgayLap AS DATE) AS order_date,
    CAST(o.ThoiGianLap AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
    l.MaHangHoa AS product_code,
    l.DanhMuc AS product_group,
    COALESCE(l.ProdName, l.MaHangHoa) AS product_name,
    l.SLQuyDoi AS qty,
    l.DonViTinh AS unit,
    l.TriGia AS amount,
    o.MaKhachHang AS customer_id,
    CASE WHEN o.MaKhachHang IS NOT NULL AND o.MaKhachHang != '' THEN c.TenGoi ELSE NULL END AS customer_name,
    o.MaNhanVien AS staff,
    o.KenhBanHang AS channel,
    o.PhuongThucTT AS payment,
    (o._huy OR o.TinhTrang = 'cancelled') AS is_cancelled,
    (o._tra OR o.TinhTrang = 'returned') AS is_returned,
    'item' AS line_kind
FROM orders o
JOIN lines l ON o.MaHoaDon = l.MaHoaDon
LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.MaKhachHang = c.MaKhachHang
